title: OrgGraph view definitions
description: Shape of the VIEWS object in env.json: named declarative projections over the graph (PRD §7). Each view is defined by a path expression (PRD FR-7.1a / E19) that fully determines shown types, render modes, and the tree-spanning hops; hierarchy is purely a view concept (PRD E18).

path.description: Path expression, e.g. "Person (<--berichtetAn-- Person, --mitgliedIn--> OE[cluster], --hatRolle--> Rolle[ring])". Grammar and semantics in PRD FR-7.1a: arrows encode the stored edge direction; round parentheses branch; square brackets set the render mode (node|cluster|hidden|ring[:prev|:next], default node; [ring] = [ring:prev], badges attach to the nearest preceding/following visible node station, PRD E21); self-typed hops are implicitly transitive; [hidden] nodes are contracted into derived edges and never serve as ring attachment targets.

roots.description: Node ids of the anchor type; "__auto__" = the roots of the tree spanned by the anchor self-hop, relative to hop traversal direction (PRD FR-7.1, E45): for <--Typ-- (descent against stored direction) nodes WITHOUT an outgoing edge of that type, for --Typ--> (traversal along stored direction) nodes WITHOUT an incoming edge. Only allowed when exactly one transitive self-hop starts at the anchor.

depth.description: Start depth; toolbar overrides at runtime (PRD FR-7.7).

time.description: Time mode (PRD FR-5.3). Internal time truth is the snapshot instant (PRD FR-5.2a, E29).

instant.description: Snapshot stamp YYYYMMDD-HHMM, ISO date-time, or ISO date (interpreted as start of day) — PRD FR-5.2a.

filters.description: Declarative restrictions applied after traversal projection, before layout (PRD FR-7.8).

type.description: Node or edge type the filter applies to.

value.description: Comparison value; node id(s) for refEq/refIn. Required for every operator except exists (PRD FR-7.8).
